title: MotionWeave: Learning Motion-Centered Future Dynamics for Vision-Language-Action Policies
abstract: arXiv:2609.39324v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently incorporated world models to provide richer dynamic supervision beyond sparse action labels. However, explicitly predicting future images or videos may include control-irrelevant appearance, while guidance derived from holistic future visual representations and shared global action features may fail to establish timestep-specific correspondence between actions and local visual changes. To address this issue, we propose MotionWeave, a motion-centric future-dynamics framework for action-chunk prediction with two modules: the Action-Induced Motion Grounder (AIMG) and the Horizon Residual Composer (HRC). Specifically, AIMG conditions on action and proprioceptive representations to construct horizon-specific queries that localize interaction regions associated with each future action timestep from current visual tokens. HRC extracts differences between interaction representations at adjacent

translated_title: MotionWeave：面向视觉-语言-动作策略的学习以运动为中心的未来动态
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型最近引入了世界模型，以提供超越稀疏动作标签的更丰富的动态监督。然而，显式预测未来图像或视频可能包含与控制无关的外观信息，而由整体未来视觉表征和共享的全局动作特征所导出的引导，可能难以在动作与局部视觉变化之间建立特定时间步的对应关系。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 MotionWeave，一个以运动为中心的未来动态框架，用于动作块预测，包含两个模块：动作诱导运动定位器和视界残差组合器。具体而言，AIMG 以动作和本体感知表征为条件，构建针对各个视界时刻的查询，从当前视觉标记中定位与每个未来动作时间步相关联的交互区域。HRC 提取相邻时刻交互表征之间的差异……
tldr: 该论文提出 MotionWeave 框架，通过动作诱导运动定位器（AIMG）和视界残差组合器（HRC）两个模块，以运动为中心建模未来动态，在动作时间步与局部视觉变化之间建立精确对应关系，从而提升视觉-语言-动作模型的动作块预测能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MotionWeave, a motion-centric future-dynamics framework that uses an Action-Induced Motion Grounder (AIMG) and a Horizon Residual Composer (HRC) to establish timestep-specific correspondence between actions and local visual changes, improving action-chunk prediction in Vision-Language-Action policies.
